world.h: Bukele to register for third term

world.title: Four bodies recovered after Senegal boat capsizes amid migration surge

national.h: Storm rain triggers emergency in South Florida
national.b: Heavy rain prompted an emergency declaration in South Florida, where a synagogue roof collapsed; planes were also grounded at SFO.

international.h: Dutch church's nonstop service passes two years

business.h: Asian stocks dive despite Anthropic debut

business.b: GTA VI went on sale Thursday after a 13-year wait, with critics calling the open-world game a "masterpiece" and "an astonishing American epic".

business.h: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share
business.b: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the expected range, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion. Shares start trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.
